summary: Browser Use grants $15 in free credits once per person to eligible signups via Google, GitHub, or Microsoft — no card required, and credits never expire. Credits pay for cloud browser time ($0.02/hour, proxies on by default) and Browser Use Agents (model tokens + 20% service fee). Pay-as-you-go top-ups start at $5; no subscription.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://browser-use.com with an eligible Google, GitHub, or Microsoft account.
$15 in free credits is granted once per person; no card required.
Credits never expire; use them for browser time or agent runs.
